newsitem.title: USA: Repap unit extends consent solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Repap unit extends consent solicitation.

text.p: Repap Wisconsin Inc, a unit of Repap Enterprises Inc, said Thursday it is extending the expiration date for the solicitation of consents from holders of its 9-1/4 percent first priority senior secured notes due 2002 and 9-7/8 percent second priority senior secured notes due 2006.
The extension is to 1600 EST/2100 GMT March 5.

The consent solicitations were sought in a statement dated February 5. As of February 26, the company, a producer of high-quality grades of recycled coated paper, said it received favorable consents from holders of greater than the necessary majority of each of the first priority and second priority notes.
